data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism's final sentence asserts 'It follows that the underlying structure was never relevant to the outcome at all,' which directly contradicts the claim's grounding of the Popperian choice in a specific structural/logical feature ('the logical asymmetry of falsification') and also undermines the entire analogy section, whose transfer claims depend on shared structure between natural selection and theory corroboration being load-bearing. If structure is irrelevant to the outcome, the choice cannot be 'grounded solely in the logical asymmetry of falsification,' and the structural parallels drawn in the analogy cannot support any transfer claim. This is an internal self-contradiction within the same artifact.
